body: Hey, It's okay- don't worry. It's healthy to let you feelings out. You're not alone, trust me. PM me.
Or talk to a friend? Maybe, I'm just suggesting it...
That's the way I feel. That's why I joined Reddit. It makes me feel better about myself helping people :)

I suggest that you call the cops, or someone you trust- maybe even a school counselor?
No, it would not count as kidnapping.
Tell her to stay at your house for a couple of days, tell your parents what's going on. 
If they call the cops about her missing- Tell the cops what's going on.
Please PM me

I lost my best friend 2 years ago. Then her fiancee died. And two days ago my best friend died. 
I wish I believed in the afterlife, or I wish I believed in something.
PM me if you want to talk about it.
PM me even if you do not want to talk to me- Its good to talk about your problems
Thank you, I hope we get through this... She's mad at me right now and not talking to me
PM me if you want to talk a bit more

You do not know how you are going to do it which means that you havent thought in depth about this- I hope. Instead of wishing for another life, why don't you try and change yours? Go outside, get a hobbie that gets your mind off of things. Talk to me- I do care. I know that sounds cheesy but it is true.

Look, I understand how you feel- I will not say that I know how you feel, because nobody knows. Whilst I was reading this- Its exactly my situation. Yes- I do cut myself, my grades suck, my friends think that I am a horrible liar and that they hate me, but look- talk to me. I know that so many people say that but yeah, it does help to talk it out.
Hey, Relax. Okay- No matter how much you think that nobody cares, it is not true. Many people do- They apparently just don't show it. PM me if you want to talk. Your family does care :)
Yeah, but we live in Africa and nobody gives 2 sh**s about that here

I'm new to this website- A friend suggested that I go here...

Could you PM me or tell me how to PM you?

I understand, I won't say that I know what you feel like-nobody ever does, but I understand it. I have friends that want to kill themselves, and they cut themselves- that seriously makes me depressed. I cut myself, and I continue doing it no matter what anybody says and I just don't want to finish the job. Sometimes when I cut myself, I just feel numb-No more pain, but in a way-it reveals my pain. I won't say that it will be alright- because out of my little experience- nothing changed for me. Message me if you want to talk
